blind.B1: Yes, with care. GSE86338 holds the paper's swimming-exercise arm: iWAT after a swimming program (S2.1.p1, S4.4.p1) versus room-temperature control iWAT. Exercise-carrying sequenced samples: GSM2300501/GSM2300502 (S2SWIM_1/2); matching control GSM2300495/GSM2300496 (S2CNT_1/2). The 10 BAT samples (cold activation, 30C whitening) carry no exercise factor.
blind.B2: Main comparison for this question: iWAT swimming vs iWAT control, n=2 vs n=2 libraries, each library a pool of RNA from 4 animals (S4.2.p1). Other iWAT arms (4C 7 d, CL316243) share the same control, n=2 each (S2.2.p1). BAT comparisons are separate experiments (S2.3.p1).
blind.B3: No repeated measures. Each library is a pool of 4 different animals (S4.2.p1), so no animal is sampled twice. Packet A's candidate key (treatment + title suffix across tissue) only links replicate index 1/2 across tissues; the expression check says not_supported and BAT/iWAT samples come from separate experiments. No real unit key exists.
blind.B4: Paper does not state the fit structure. It says only that DE was done with Cuffdiff in the Cufflinks package (S4.3.1.p1); it does not say whether conditions were fitted jointly or as pairs.
blind.B5: FDR <= 0.05 and absolute fold-change >= 2 (Fig 1 legend: absolute log2FC >= 1), written as 'absolute fold-change >=2-fold, false discovery rate [FDR] <= 0.05' (S2.2.p1; Fig 1 legend). Exercise: 673 up and 826 down mRNAs in iWAT; lncRNAs 49 up and 98 down. Cold 1,062/1,201; CL316243 837/681.

checks.evidence: Series has a swimming iWAT arm (S2.1.p1, S4.4.p1); the case identifies it as the primary contrast and refuses only at the design gate, not on missing exercise arm.

grp derived from title: CNT, CL, COLD, SWIM, each n=2, matching the paper's 2 pooled libraries per condition (S4.2.p1). 10 BAT samples excluded with named reasons (separate experiments with own controls). SWIM compared with the shared iWAT control, as in S2.2.p1.
Contrast declared as control CNT, treatment SWIM (and COLD, CL vs CNT); no result produced.

Mechanical flags unused_subject_like_column and pairing_key_candidate are false positives: treatment label + title suffix only matches replicate index across tissues; libraries are pools of 4 animals (S4.2.p1); pairing_check status not_supported (r diff 0.75 but p=0.04 from 6 pairs, flagged not_supported). repeated_measure_unit recorded as none with reason.

Paper is silent on joint vs pairwise fit (S4.3.1.p1). paper_reconstruction/rejected alternatives state 'the paper's Cuffdiff run models all iWAT conditions together', which the paper does not say. No fit was run, so no effect.
checks.fix: Reword the rejected-alternative reason to say the paper does not state the fit structure.

checks.evidence: Only one sex (male, per suitability). Not noted: cold mice individually housed at 4C (S4.4.p1) while swimming/control housing is unstated; GEO lists all iWAT as 16 weeks old vs 8-week start in paper, recorded as discrepancy. No aliasing with the exercise factor is evident.

Matrix is Cufflinks FPKM (gene_fpkm.txt.gz, non-integer, median ~0); route log2(FPKM+1) then limma is correct for linear normalized values; Cuffdiff route correctly declared a deviation since no counts/alignments were deposited.
Recorded FDR <= 0.05, |log2FC| >= 1, inclusive, with source locator; matches S2.2.p1 and Fig 1 legend.
No DE run; HANDBACK states 673 up / 826 down for exercise (S2.2.p1) and gives cold/CL counts only as context. No claim beyond the numbers.

'n < 3' is an absence claim; it was checked against the data and the paper: 4 iWAT arms with 2 libraries each, 0/6 comparisons with >=3 per group (suitability.md), and the paper itself states pools of 4 animals with 2 pools per condition (S4.2.p1). No hidden replicates or other iWAT swim samples in the series (18 samples, all accounted for).

human_items: Open policy question: whether to allow a labelled exploratory sensitivity run (limma ~grp on 8 iWAT samples, SWIM vs CNT, n=2 vs 2 pools) next to the refused record, since the paper itself reports 673/826 DEGs from n=2 pools.
summary: 该系列确实包含游泳运动组(iWAT, 每组2个由4只小鼠混合的文库),以n<3为由在设计阶段拒绝,理由与论文(S4.2.p1)和适用性报告一致。机械标记的配对键只是跨组织的重复序号,并非动物标识,属于误报。阈值、方向、分组均与论文一致,仅有一处措辞性小问题(论文未说明Cuffdiff是否联合建模)。
